description_for_human: Generate, rig, find and inspect 3D models and avatars (GLB) from a text description.
description_for_model: Tools from the three.ws 3D Studio remote MCP server. Use them to turn a text description into a textured, downloadable GLB 3D model or a rigged avatar, to auto-rig an existing GLB, to refine a generated model by describing a change, to look at a model from several angles, to search the catalog of ready-made CC0 3D assets and get paste-ready embed code, and to search the three.ws documentation. Generation is asynchronous: generation tools may return status pending with a job_id and a viewer_url, and check_job collects the finished model.
